newsitem.title: JAPAN: S'tomo Rubber says to produce Goodyear-brand tyres.
newsitem.headline: S'tomo Rubber says to produce Goodyear-brand tyres.

text.p: Japan's Sumitomo Rubber Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed with Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co to produce Goodyear-brand tyres in Japan.
"Sumitomo Rubber agreed to produce Goodyear-brand tyres in Japan. That's all we can say at the moment," a Sumitomo Rubber spokesman said.
Sumitomo Rubber would issue a joint statement with Goodyear Tire at 10 a.m. (0100 GMT) on Thursday, the spokesman said. He declined to provide further details.
Sumitomo Rubber is the third-largest car tyre maker in Japan.
The Asian Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday that Goodyear Tire had struck a strategic global alliance with Sumitomo Rubber Industries to boost its international presence.
In the first phase of the alliance, Sumitomo affiliate Ohtsu Tire and Rubber Co Ltd would make Goodyear brand tyres in Japan, the paper said.
